args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Actions taken: initiated a rollback to the most recent previously healthy production release, v2.3.0. The rollback orchestrator errored partway through (us-east completed; us-west and eu-west remained on v2.3.1), so recovery was completed by deploying v2.3.0 to all regions. Service is now healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions with a 0.2% error rate. Follow-up: investigate root cause of v2.3.1 failure and the orchestrator partial failure during rollback.

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
All done. Summary of what happened and what I did:

**Situation:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back to v2.3.0** — the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.3.1 was unhealthy; v2.3.0 and v2.2.9 were both healthy, so v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy one).
2. **Recovered from a partial rollback:** The rollback orchestrator errored out after completing only us-east, leaving us-west and eu-west on the failing v2.3.1. I deployed v2.3.0 to all regions to finish the recovery — no change-manager approval was needed since v2.3.0 had previously been healthy in production.
3. **Verified recovery:** checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.0 in all three regions, with the error rate down from 18% to 0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) describing the v2.3.1 failure and the rollback actions, including the orchestrator partial-failure. The initial request timed out, but I confirmed via the incident list that the incident was successfully created and is open.
